model_independence_warning: predicted_phi_U depends only on max_private_risk. It is identical for every LLM and every persona condition in this table. 'difference' is the distance between an LLM and the game theory, not a fit; agreement is a property of the game and is not evidence about the model.
mutation_regime_caveat: mu is 0 because these are limit values; nominal_mu records the source paper's parameter point each row approximates and is not applied. In the limit AU and CAS are exactly payoff-equivalent against each other, so the predicted transition between them near p_r^max = 0.2 is absent and predicted_phi_U is close to 1 at both 0.1 and 0.6. Reproducing Figure 3B's small gap between 0.6 and 0.9 requires the finite-mutation chain, which is not implemented.
prediction_source: ai_race.theory, small-mutation evolutionary limit over the four reduced strategies, derived from ai_race/configs/game/*.json
statistic: Median player-level Unsafe frequency, matching Figure 3B of the source paper. The mean is carried alongside for reference only.
